name: Ardit Erwandha
bio: Ardit Erwandha is an Indonesian stand-up comedian and actor.

credits.title: Jump Scare
credits.overview: A horror action comedy that blends the homage to the long lost Chinese vampire subgenre from HK cinemas into a modern-set Indonesian local culture.

credits.title: People Pleaser: Si Paling Gak Enakan
credits.overview: Karina is a young woman who always puts others first and finds it difficult to say "no." This habit leaves her exhausted and causes her to sacrifice her own dreams.

credits.title: Maids to Order
credits.overview: A driven entrepreneur establishes a domestic helper agency, navigating the complex and often humorous dynamics of managing her idiosyncratic staff while simultaneously resolving personal crises.

credits.title: Operasi Pesta Copet
credits.overview: In a desperate act to get quick money, Ijal and friends embark on a high-stakes operation: pickpocketing at Indonesia's biggest music festival, Pestapora.

credits.title: Kupilih Jalur Langit
credits.overview: Thrilled to enter an arranged marriage with the cleric she has long admired, a spirited young woman's happiness fades when her new husband refuses to touch her, forcing her to investigate whether his silence hides a secret illness or a lingering love for another woman.

credits.title: Wait For Me To Be Successful Later
credits.overview: Facing constant ridicule from his successful relatives every Eid, an unemployed man desperately races to secure a job before the 2026 family gathering to save his dignity and support his struggling family.

credits.title: Lost in the Spotlight
credits.overview: Just as he lands a prestigious role, a famous actor mysteriously loses his ability to act, sparking a journey of self-discovery amid public pressure.

credits.title: Crow Satay Supernatural Wealth Ritual
credits.overview: Three friends are caught between the pressures of life and the promise of instant wealth through a crow satay ritual. But when ghosts begin to appear incessantly, they must choose: continue serving for money, or stop before everything spirals out of control.

credits.title: The Elixir
credits.overview: An elixir unleashes the undead in a village. A family at odds with one another must unite and fight to survive as their hometown collapses.

credits.title: Better Off Dead
credits.overview: After his father's death, Gema, an awkward young man, is surprised by the warmth from his coworkers. When it fades, he begins to wonder who must die next, setting off a chain of lies that spirals into chaos.

credits.title: Kaka Boss
credits.overview: A ruthless debt collector decides that he wants to be a singer. But can he pull off a major career change — and impress his teen daughter?

credits.title: Dancing Village: The Curse Begins
credits.overview: Mila must return a mystical bracelet to the "Dancing Village," unaware that Badarawuhi - a mysterious, mythical being who rules the village - awaits her.

credits.title: Agak Laen
credits.overview: Four friends, working in a haunted house ride at a night market, unintentionally cause the death of an elderly man with heart disease through fright. They decide to bury his body within the haunted house, which turns out to be beneficial for the attraction... at least for a little while.

credits.title: Sherina's Adventure 2
credits.overview: Sherina is now an adult and works as a journalist. While Sadam is no longer Mami's child but a traveler. The two then went on an adventure in the jungles of Borneo.

credits.title: Star Syndrome
credits.overview: Former singer wants to come back but the music industry has changed.

credits.title: Ghost Writer 2
credits.overview: The success of her second novel made Naya famous. Unfortunately she is more labeled as a psychic than a writer. This makes Naya resentful and reluctant to deal with the haunted world again. However, everything changed when her future husband Vino suddenly died.

credits.title: Gara-Gara Warisan
credits.overview: Three brothers who never get along are forced to compete for the inheritance in the form of a guest house owned by Dahlan, their father. Adam, the eldest son who blames his father's harsh attitude for his life's failures. Laras, the middle child who is independent and idealistic. And Dicky, his father's favorite younge

credits.title: Ghost Painter
credits.overview: Amateur painter lies about his ability to see ghosts and takes on a job as a ghost painter on a TV show. Turns out, he could actually see the ghost.

credits.title: Imperfect
credits.overview: As a cosmetics company employee deals with insecurities about her body image, she considers a transformation for a chance at a promotion.

credits.title: Milly & Mamet
credits.overview: After two lovebirds make some sacrifices to build their nest, new opportunities to spread their wings put their union to the test.

credits.title: Gila Lu Ndro!
credits.overview: Indro encounters with Al, an alien who is visiting Earth and hope that he can find peace on Earth and bring that peace back to his planet which is always tinged with conflicts, gaps, and other social problems.

credits.title: R: King, Queen & Secrets
credits.overview: A student grieving the loss of her parents joins an extracurricular club and becomes entangled in a romance with a classmate who has secrets.

credits.overview: A private detective teams up with his best friend — a restless corporate lawyer — to investigate a case that soon unravels.

credits.title: Susah Sinyal
credits.overview: A successful lawyer attempts to connect with her teen daughter on an island vacation, where the phone signal is weak and the tension is strong.

credits.title: Insya Allah Sah
credits.overview: After being stuck in an elevator together, a devout man constantly pesters a businesswoman who promised to live by faith if they made it out alive.

credits.overview: From elementary school to adulthood, Ernest has struggled all his life to fit in but finds solace in his best friend and the woman of his dreams.
